title: COMO DANÇAR MÚSICA ELETRÔNICA | 4 Passos de Psy Rebolation

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down psy rebolation dance steps step-by-step with clear verbal explanations and physical demonstrations. He structures the lesson progressively from isolated foot exercises to full movement combinations.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to electronic music styles and the rebolation dance.
Demonstration of rebolation dance steps to music.
Step-by-step breakdown of the first rebolation step with preparatory exercises.
Breakdown and exercises for the second rebolation step.
Breakdown and exercises for the third rebolation step.
Breakdown and exercises for the fourth rebolation step.
Advice on mixing movements and adding personal style.
Closing remarks, call to action to subscribe and like.

safety: Flexionar um pouco o joelho para quando for jogar a perna estendê-lo

steps_taught.name: Primeiro passo
steps_taught.description: Base movement involving shifting body weight to the front of the foot and moving legs forward and back.

steps_taught.name: Segundo passo
steps_taught.description: Similar to the first step, but throwing the leg backward instead of forward.

steps_taught.name: Terceiro passo
steps_taught.description: Similar to previous steps, but performed laterally to the side.

steps_taught.name: Quarto passo
steps_taught.description: Constantly opening and closing the heels while transferring weight between legs.

what_works: Isolating foot and weight transfer exercises before combining them into full movements
Clear verbal instructions paired with frontal view demonstrations
what_hinders: Lack of counts to music makes timing difficult to follow

quotes.text: Portanto, começarei ensinando quatro passos desse estilo.
O primeiro passo é um movimento que nos dará base para todos os outros.
E o último exercício já é um movimento completo.
Por último, vocês podem começar a misturar os movimentos.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates the first basic step facing front with a plain white background.
Close-up shot on feet showing heel lifts and shifting weight.
Footwork close-up for the first step repetition.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: precise friction or floor surface grip

evidence_segments.observation: Close-up on foot placement for the second step variation.
Close-up of crossing foot pattern for the third step.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down each movement into isolated foot exercises (weight on forefoot, heel lifts) before teaching the full traveling step combination.
